payload.title: Add harness arms F, F-rand, A-c and A-c+F and pass offline end to end (S0)
payload.description:
## Purpose

Add arms F, F-rand, A-c and A-c+F to the unified harness and run every arm offline end to end on the fake Jev.

## Scope

- **F:** fixed list from core `improve_example_list` (k = 4 per label + 1 reserve), its few-shot answer as one head feature.
- **F-rand:** `RandomBalanced` fixed list redrawn each round, same k (the control).
- **A-c:** arm A with comments passed through `_record_feedback` (`edit_comment_value`); offline uses fake comments until the L2 labeler exists.
- **A-c+F:** A-c elements + F feature; shares F's few-shot answers.
- Reuse `_ensure_fewshot` with a fixed-list context fingerprint. Separate few-shot request per item (design default; Q2 open).
- New spend ledger with a **cumulative ceiling of 7,500 Jev requests**; dev-100 and paper-600 always in `protected_ids`.

## Definition of done

Specs first, no network: offline run of all arms with `FakeJevCore` passes; ceiling enforced; protected IDs never enter lists or development; F and F-rand fingerprints differ. `make test` green. **Stop S0. Cost: $0.**

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §1.3, §3.2, §5.2, §6 step 3.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-886c718d-c0f7-4384-81e9-7ad29677be98`.
